en.headline: Business owners in {region} at the moment they need advice
en.subheadline: Every week {firma} gets companies around {ort} that were just registered or are hiring several people – the points where pensions, protection and employee benefits come up.

signals.title: New directors
signals.text: Setting up a company raises questions about director protection, pensions and how to pay themselves tax-efficiently.

signals.title: Teams growing
signals.text: Employers hiring several people at once need workplace pensions and often start looking at benefits.

signals.title: Checked and sourced
signals.text: Each lead shows the company, date, address and the official source, so {firma} can prepare the first conversation.

faq.a: Only companies in the areas you choose – for example {region} – with a fresh, dated event that gives you a reason to get in touch. Each lead is delivered to you once.

faq.q: Where does the data come from?
faq.a: Official company registers, official announcements and companies' own careers pages. We do not use LinkedIn, job boards or other platforms whose terms forbid it.

faq.q: Is there personal data in the leads?
faq.a: No. Company data only: name, address, website, main phone number where published, the event and its source.

faq.q: How does this fit a financial adviser?
faq.a: Business owners rarely look for an adviser until something changes. We flag those changes in {region} so your first call is timely and relevant.

faq.q: What does the free sample include?
faq.a: 10 current leads from {region}, with the same fields as the weekly delivery. No obligation, no card required.

fr.headline: Les dirigeants de {region} au moment où ils ont besoin de conseil
fr.subheadline: Chaque semaine, {firma} reçoit les sociétés créées récemment autour de {ort} – le moment où se posent la protection du dirigeant et l'épargne salariale.

signals.title: Nouveaux dirigeants
signals.text: La création d'une société soulève des questions de protection, de retraite et de rémunération du dirigeant.

signals.title: Source officielle
signals.text: Chaque piste indique la société, la date, l'adresse et l'annonce BODACC correspondante.

faq.a: Uniquement des entreprises de vos zones – par exemple {region} – avec un événement récent et daté qui justifie une prise de contact. Chaque piste ne vous est livrée qu'une fois.
Registres officiels, annonces légales (BODACC) et pages carrières des entreprises. Ni LinkedIn ni sites d'emploi.
Non. Uniquement des données d'entreprise : nom, adresse, site, standard si publié, l'événement et sa source.
10 pistes actuelles de {region}, avec les mêmes champs que la livraison hebdomadaire. Sans engagement.
